data.name: Space Pizza Express
data.detailed_description:
A funny arcade space-action game about delivering pizza across the galaxy in short, chaotic 5–10 minute runs.

The job perks include zero-gravity working conditions and unlimited cheese snacks.
The job hazards include flying debris, stolen pizzas, and unhappy intergalactic customers.

Pick up the order, boost through dangerous space routes, dodge asteroids and satellites, and try to complete the delivery before alien thieves turn your shift into a disaster. Some enemies will steal your pizza and run. Others will slow you down so the theft goes smoothly. Management, naturally, still expects on-time delivery.

Built as a short and replayable arcade experience, the game is designed for players who want to jump in, survive a frantic delivery run, and come back for a better score.

KEY FEATURES

  • FAST-PACED ARCADE GAMEPLAY – Quick movement, quick decisions, quick disasters

  • 5–10 MINUTE RUNS – A compact experience that respects your time

  • PIZZA DEFENSE – Keep alien thieves away from your order

  • BOOST MANAGEMENT – Stay fast, escape danger, and optimize your route

  • SPACE HAZARDS – Dodge asteroids, satellites, and other flying problems

  • REPLAYABLE RUNS – Learn the patterns, sharpen your route, and improve your score

  • LIGHTHEARTED SCI-FI STYLE – Space delivery has never looked this unsafe

ONE MORE DELIVERY

This is a small, focused, affordable arcade experience made for players who enjoy fast action, short sessions, and chasing cleaner runs.

The galaxy is hungry.
Try not to lose the pizza.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: Core i7-6700 or Ryzen 5 1600
  • Memory: 12 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce GTX 1060 6GB or Radeon RX 580 8GB or Arc A380
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: 64-bit Windows 10
  • Processor: Core i7-12700 or Ryzen 7 7800X3D
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: GeForce RTX 2060 SUPER or Radeon RX 5700 XT or Arc A770
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 5 GB available space

mac_requirements.minimum:

  • Processor: M1

  • Storage: 5 GB available space

  • OS: macOS: 15.5 or later
  • Processor: M3 Pro
  • Memory: 16 MB RAM
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
